Hi, I'm Qiqi! Last time I grew big and small, today I went to a purple forest and met a cat that only had a smile! Ready? Let's go!
Qiqi walked through the little door and came to a forest she had never seen before. The trees were tall, the leaves were purple, and the flowers were singing!
But as she walked, Qiqi noticed every tree looked the same. She kept walking in circles. "Am I lost?"
Just then, a strange sound came from above. Qiqi looked up — in the dark shadows of the trees, a glowing smile appeared! Just a smile, no body!
Slowly, two ears appeared next to the smile, and then a purple cat. It sat on the branch, smiling at Qiqi.
Meow~ Hello, I'm the Cheshire Cat. You seem to be lost.
How did you know? I've been walking forever, but every tree looks the same! I don't know which way to go!
The Cheshire Cat didn't answer. Its smile grew bigger and bigger, and then — its body disappeared! Only the smile remained on the tree.
Meow~ Qiqi, if you don't know where you're going, any road will do~
But I really don't know where to go! I just want to go home!
Qiqi reached out to catch the smile, but it slowly faded away too. She stood alone in the forest, a little scared.
But then Qiqi remembered the Cheshire Cat's words. She took a deep breath, stopped, and quietly looked around. Golden light shone through the leaves onto her.
Wow! There's a sign behind the tree! It says "Tea Party →"! Someone is having a tea party!
Qiqi followed the sign and wasn't afraid anymore. In the distance, she could hear teacups clinking — something fun was waiting for her ahead.
It turns out that when you're lost, the most important thing isn't to go fast — it's to stop first and look around for help.
Little friends, if you ever get lost too, remember Qiqi's trick — stop, take a deep breath, and look around you.
Next time, Qiqi will attend a tea party that never stops, with a Mad Hatter who never stops drinking tea. See you tomorrow! Goodnight!
